collision_energy.evidence: ITMS2 spectra were collected with an AGC target of 10 000, max injection time of 70ms and CID collision energy of 35%.

enrichment_method.evidence: Stably transduced cell lines were used for GFP-trap experiments as described above, and samples on beads were submitted for proteomic analysis.

fractionation_method.evidence: Eluate from the SepPak cartridge was evaporated to dryness and resuspended in buffer A (20 mM ammonium hydroxide, pH 10) prior to fractionation by high pH reversed-phase chromatography using an Ultimate 3000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo Scientific).
